translation: Belum pernah sebelumnya negara berdaulat itu mengalami embargo perdagangan internasional yang sedemikian berat.
targetSentence: Never before had the sovereign nation experienced such severe international trade embargoes.
indonesianPrompt: Belum pernah negara berdaulat itu mengalami embargo perdagangan internasional yang begitu berat.
acceptedAnswers: Never before had the sovereign nation experienced such severe international trade embargoes.
Never before had the sovereign nation experienced such severe international trade embargoes
